description: Defines configuration structures, enums, and classes for the SDR Radio Unit in a wireless communication system, including expert settings, thread profiles, logging, and frequency calibration.

classes.name: ru_sdr_unit_expert_config
classes.description: Configuration for system throttling, transmission mode, and power ramping of the SDR Radio Unit.

classes.name: amplitude_control_unit_config
classes.description: Settings for gain backoff, power ceiling, and clipping of baseband samples.

classes.name: ru_sdr_unit_logger_config
classes.description: Logging levels configuration for radio and physical layers.

classes.name: ru_sdr_unit_cpu_affinities_cell_config
classes.description: CPU affinity mask configuration for radio unit workers per cell.

classes.name: ru_sdr_unit_expert_threads_config
classes.description: Configuration of thread profiles for the SDR Radio Unit, with automatic profile selection based on CPU count.

classes.name: ru_sdr_unit_expert_execution_config
classes.description: Expert thread and CPU affinity configurations for the SDR Radio Unit.

classes.name: ru_sdr_unit_metrics_config
classes.description: Metrics collection configuration and enable flag.

classes.name: ru_sdr_unit_config
classes.description: Main configuration structure for the SDR Radio Unit, including frequency, gains, calibration, and expert settings.
